correctness.rationale: For all n>=1, set t=2n-1, a=v3(t), b=v5(t). Elementary LTE gives v3(A)=2a+1 and v5(A)=b; modulo-3 and modulo-5 unit comparisons after stripping 15^min yield all digit cases, including equality. The five t mod5 classes produce exactly three deterministic edges plus two conditional stars. CRT independences yield the precise conditional weights 12/37, 20/37 and 5/37 and uniform four-unit residues, so q, the 20-edge support and all transition masses follow. A finite partition into valuation strata plus uniform congruence counting gives O(log^2 N); the measure tails contribute O(1). Direct independent integer calculations for n<=300 and 200000 pair tests in verify.py corroborate formulas but are not used as an infinite proof. No unresolved lemma or unverified computational premise.

value.rationale: Exactly classifying every permitted consecutive symbol in a natural number-theoretic automatic sequence, with nonuniform rational probabilities and explicit O(log^2 N) prefix error, is a complete local arithmetic-dynamical invariant. It exposes a sharp 20-edge constraint and two statistically distinct 3/37 and 5/37 conditional classes not expressed by the preexisting automaticity statement. This is a motivated, exact standalone fact with a plausible use as a baseline for higher-block statistics, rather than a renaming, arbitrary parameter slice or known-table recalc.
